page.overview:
Who is Karoo?

Karoo is Nefertari Vivi's pet super spot-billed duck. A fleet riding bird, one of the fastest modes of transportation available in the Arabasta Kingdom, he is captain of the Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops.

Alongside Vivi, Karoo infiltrated the criminal syndicate Baroque Works, eventually uncovering Sir Crocodile's conspiracy against Arabsta. After their covers were blown, he joined his mistress as a traveling companion to the Straw Hat Pirates for most of the Arabasta Saga.

Karoo is a duck of yellow-brown plumage, with black-tipped wings and tailfeathers. Typical of his species, he bears a black band around his bill and stands roughly as tall as the average human; his feet are tetradactyl, with ostrich-like talons (unlike the webbed feet of normal ducks).

His default wear consists of a blue-and-white (typically unbuckled), pink goggles, and a large saddle carrying multiple saddlebags. When travelling, he prefers to wear a barrel-shaped canteen around his neck, complete with drinking-straw.
